name: prr_read_rules
description: Read a repository's rule files at its default branch (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/instructions/*.instructions.md, .cursor/BUGBOT.md) with numbered lines and what each applies to, and the review comments on its last 60 merged pull requests, for the scout. Without repo: starts prr-setup for each watched repository (Read the repositories again).
